meta.purpose: Last-verified funding tracker for AdugboInsure. Only list opportunities that were actually checked.
rules: Use states active, watched, stale, rejected, unknown.
Every retained item needs source, last_verified, and deadline or null.
If no opportunity was freshly verified, summaries must say so plainly.
If shallow search/fetch results look thin, contradictory, or claim 404/closed, verify the official page with agent-browser before retaining or rejecting the opportunity.
